scope.outcome: One public repository package now reports bounded, derived coverage across four fixed public SEIS Repo registry projections. The first 30 Wave 5 steps are implemented and validated locally; step 31 starts the next resilience-review tranche. No personal marketplace, external write, network, secret, installation, runtime, provider, deployment, signing, or release claim is authorized.
scope.entryRule: Wave 4 closed with a historical candidate review, the separate Wave 5 activation decision records current user authority and bounded scope, and the active package has current public source, catalog, matrix, marketplace, evidence, and deny-by-default permission projections.

nonGoals: Adding a second Wave 5 package or card without a separate capability decision.
Reading or mutating a personal marketplace, using a network, granting writes or secrets, or changing protected branches.
Returning raw registry content, raw descriptions, raw capability phrases, raw plugin names, absolute paths, or machine-specific paths.
Treating static coverage as installation, MCP activation, runtime, provider, deployment, signing, or release proof.

rounds.objective: Keep the coverage package interoperable with existing registry and marketplace contracts without expanding its authority.

rounds.name: Wave 5 closeout and next-series decision
rounds.objective: Finish only when all remaining steps have current evidence; keep future series activation separate and human-authorized.

risks.description: Coverage summaries could be confused with the validators they complement.
risks.mitigation: Keep explicit boundaries, fixed inputs, aggregate-only outputs, and separate existing validators.

risks.description: Future registry schema growth could exceed the bounded parser assumptions.
risks.mitigation: Fail closed to attention, retain fixture tests, and require a new scoped decision before widening the contract.

rollback.scope: Revert the focused Wave 5 package, generated evidence, public card projection, and program records on the feature branch; no external state or data migration exists.
